method: ENTIRELY from AMH's General principles: immunomodulators page, read under subscription and PARAPHRASED: no passage reproduced, no source_text stored, so NOTHING here is machine re-checkable. This is a PRINCIPLES page, not a treatment topic: it carries almost no doses and is written here as the screening, vaccination and infection-risk checklist that applies BEFORE and DURING any immunomodulator, whatever the indication. Seven other guidelines in this compendium prescribe drugs this page governs.

claims.claim: Immunomodulators STIMULATE OR SUPPRESS the immune system via different mechanisms, and are used in a wide range of autoimmune and inflammatory diseases including rheumatoid arthritis, psoriasis, ulcerative colitis, Crohn's disease, systemic lupus erythematosus and vasculitis, AS WELL AS IN ORGAN TRANSPLANTATION
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: immunomodulators' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/immunomodulators-anti-inflammatories/general-principles-immunomodulators, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: Before starting, IDENTIFY AND TREAT ANY ACTIVE OR LATENT INFECTIONS INCLUDING TB
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: immunomodulators' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/immunomodulators-anti-inflammatories/general-principles-immunomodulators, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: SCREEN ALL PATIENTS FOR HEPATITIS B, as there is a RISK OF REACTIVATION with immunosuppression; seek specialist advice if tests are positive as ANTIVIRAL PROPHYLAXIS MAY BE REQUIRED
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: immunomodulators' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/immunomodulators-anti-inflammatories/general-principles-immunomodulators, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: In potential TRANSPLANT RECIPIENTS, additional screening includes Epstein-Barr virus, CMV, varicella-zoster virus, HIV and hepatitis C
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: immunomodulators' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/immunomodulators-anti-inflammatories/general-principles-immunomodulators, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: IMMUNE RESPONSE TO INACTIVATED VACCINES MAY BE REDUCED while immunosuppressed, and MOST LIVE VACCINES ARE CONTRAINDICATED IN SEVERE IMMUNOSUPPRESSION because of the risk of vaccine-related disease
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: immunomodulators' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/immunomodulators-anti-inflammatories/general-principles-immunomodulators, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: Consider any history of malignant disease, and PERFORM A DENTAL EXAMINATION IF POSSIBLE to manage potential sources of infection
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: immunomodulators' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/immunomodulators-anti-inflammatories/general-principles-immunomodulators, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: THE RISK AND SEVERITY OF INFECTION ARE RELATED TO THE DEGREE OF IMMUNOSUPPRESSION, WHICH VARIES DEPENDING ON THE IMMUNOMODULATOR
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: immunomodulators' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/immunomodulators-anti-inflammatories/general-principles-immunomodulators, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: The decision to start or continue an immunomodulator in a patient with infection depends on the type of infection including whether active or latent, its severity, whether it can be treated or controlled, and the indication for the immunomodulator; USE CAUTION WITH A HISTORY OF RECURRENT INFECTIONS and seek specialist advice if unsure
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: immunomodulators' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/immunomodulators-anti-inflammatories/general-principles-immunomodulators, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: Immunosuppression may increase the risk of OPPORTUNISTIC INFECTIONS, REACTIVATION OF LATENT INFECTIONS or SERIOUS INFECTIONS such as TB, hepatitis B, varicella-zoster virus, CMV and aspergillosis
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: immunomodulators' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/immunomodulators-anti-inflammatories/general-principles-immunomodulators, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: ⚠️ INFECTIONS MAY BE MORE DIFFICULT TO RECOGNISE BECAUSE THE USUAL SIGNS AND SYMPTOMS ARE OFTEN REDUCED, OFTEN PROGRESS RAPIDLY AND REQUIRE EARLY TREATMENT -- PATIENTS SHOULD KNOW HOW TO OBTAIN TREATMENT AT ANY TIME
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: immunomodulators' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/immunomodulators-anti-inflammatories/general-principles-immunomodulators, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: Options for reducing infection risk include ISONIAZID for latent TB infection, ANTIVIRAL PROPHYLAXIS in inactive hepatitis B, and PNEUMOCOCCAL AND ANNUAL INFLUENZA VACCINATIONS
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: immunomodulators' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/immunomodulators-anti-inflammatories/general-principles-immunomodulators, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: IMMUNOSUPPRESSED PATIENTS SHOULD AVOID EXPOSURE TO CHICKENPOX AND MEASLES as infections can be severe; seek specialist advice if a patient is exposed to chickenpox or shingles during therapy, and consider NORMAL IMMUNOGLOBULIN FOR MEASLES and ZOSTER IMMUNOGLOBULIN FOR CHICKENPOX OR SHINGLES
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: immunomodulators' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/immunomodulators-anti-inflammatories/general-principles-immunomodulators, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: After organ transplantation, prophylaxis for opportunistic infections may be used depending on the organ and risk factors -- TRIMETHOPRIM WITH SULFAMETHOXAZOLE for P. jirovecii and Toxoplasma gondii, and ANTIFUNGALS for Candida and Aspergillus; CMV prevention with VALGANCICLOVIR OR GANCICLOVIR may be required as prophylaxis or pre-emptive therapy
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: immunomodulators' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/immunomodulators-anti-inflammatories/general-principles-immunomodulators, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: IMMUNOSUPPRESSION INCREASES THE RISK OF MALIGNANCIES, PARTICULARLY OF THE SKIN, and of lymphoproliferative disorders such as lymphomas; RISK INCREASES WITH THE DEGREE AND DURATION OF IMMUNOSUPPRESSION
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: immunomodulators' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/immunomodulators-anti-inflammatories/general-principles-immunomodulators, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: EXAMINE SKIN REGULARLY FOR SIGNS OF CANCER; patients should avoid direct sun exposure, use a sunscreen with a high SPF of 30 or 50+, and wear a broad-brimmed hat and suitable clothing outdoors
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: immunomodulators' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/immunomodulators-anti-inflammatories/general-principles-immunomodulators, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: Drugs used to prevent transplant rejection are CALCINEURIN INHIBITORS (ciclosporin, tacrolimus), CORTICOSTEROIDS such as prednisolone, IMMUNOSUPPRESSANT ANTIBODIES such as antithymocyte globulins and basiliximab, mTOR INHIBITORS (everolimus, sirolimus), and OTHER IMMUNOSUPPRESSANTS (azathioprine, mycophenolate)
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: immunomodulators' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/immunomodulators-anti-inflammatories/general-principles-immunomodulators, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: Transplant regimens usually COMBINE DRUGS FROM MORE THAN ONE CLASS, taking advantage of different modes of action TO IMPROVE EFFICACY AND REDUCE TOXICITY; drug choice depends on the organ transplanted and is tailored for each patient
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: immunomodulators' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/immunomodulators-anti-inflammatories/general-principles-immunomodulators, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: The INTENSITY OF IMMUNOSUPPRESSION IS INITIALLY HIGH but tends to be reduced to a maintenance level determined by individual factors and the organ type; the intensity required to preserve transplant function is BALANCED AGAINST THE RISK OF POST-TRANSPLANT SKIN CANCER, LYMPHOMA, INFECTION AND END-ORGAN TOXICITY
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: immunomodulators' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/immunomodulators-anti-inflammatories/general-principles-immunomodulators, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: In ACUTE CELLULAR rejection, HIGH-DOSE CORTICOSTEROIDS are usually preferred, with ANTITHYMOCYTE GLOBULIN used if corticosteroid-resistant rejection occurs
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: immunomodulators' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/immunomodulators-anti-inflammatories/general-principles-immunomodulators, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: ANTIBODY-MEDIATED (HUMORAL) rejection may also occur, and treatment has included PLASMAPHERESIS, IV IMMUNOGLOBULIN, ANTITHYMOCYTE GLOBULIN, RITUXIMAB or a combination; SEVERE rejection may require an increase in baseline immunosuppression or a change of agent
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: immunomodulators' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/immunomodulators-anti-inflammatories/general-principles-immunomodulators, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22
